newAnalysis.processing: Our AI is processing the report and generating insights.
newAnalysis.title: Financial analysis, straight from the source.
newAnalysis.desc: Choose a company and a period. We find the public filing, analyze it, and show where each document came from.
newAnalysis.autoSearchInfo: The system will find the official report for you.
newAnalysis.autoModeDesc: Enter the company name and period. No download needed.
newAnalysis.manualModeDesc: Upload the document you want analyzed.
newAnalysis.autoCallInfo: We will look for a public earnings-call transcript.
newAnalysis.autoCallDisclaimer: Availability varies by company. If no public source is available, upload the transcript PDF.
newAnalysis.pdfModeDesc: Use your PDF when no public source is available.
newAnalysis.callModeDesc: Analyze an earnings call transcript in PDF format.
newAnalysis.manualFallbackNote: If the document cannot be found, manual upload remains available.
newAnalysis.autoDisclaimer: Coverage depends on publication by the company, SEC, or B3. The source link appears in the result.
newAnalysis.stepOne: Choose the company, year, and quarter.
newAnalysis.stepTwo: We locate a public document for the selected period.
newAnalysis.stepThree: AI analyzes the PDF and presents the report with its source.
newAnalysis.requiredFields: Enter a company, a four-digit year, and a PDF for manual analysis.
